category_title: Low-achieving students who identify a lack of depth and thought-provoking questions in their inquiry
minimal_context: The student is evaluating their individual contributions to the Knowledge Forum using the Knowledge Connections Analyzer tool.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open the Knowledge Connections Analyzer tool and use your task sheet to evaluate your individual contributions to the Knowledge Forum.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay, I am looking at it. I am just noticing the quantitative data generated by the KCA right now, like how many times things were clicked.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do those numbers tell you about your notes?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: According to the KCA data, my notes have been read a lot, but built on less. What is worse, no notes are referred to by others.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How do you feel about that result?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am not happy with the quality of my notes; it has much room to be improved. I am wondering whether my notes have been improved and the ideas have been developed. My notes lack thought-provoking questions, but I am only seeing these numbers and I'm not sure how to use this to actually fix the problem.

task.content: Evaluating individual contribution to the community discourse using the Knowledge Connections Analyzer (KCA) tool and analyzing own notes.
task.learning_goal: To reflect on individual performance and interactions with other students, identify own strengths and weaknesses, and areas for future improvement.

context.environment: Classroom setting integrating classroom discussion with the students' work on Knowledge Forum
context.materials: Knowledge Connections Analyzer (KCA) tool, KCA task sheets, reflective journal prompt, Knowledge Forum, wires of various colors for three-dimensional mind-maps, physical knowledge wall
context.social_setting: Small groups of students collaboratively constructing mind-maps, working as a community, augmented by whole-class and small-group discussion
context.time_context: Initial phase (weeks 1-5) and reflective assessment phase

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Initial use of the Knowledge Connections Analyzer (KCA) tool and viewing quantitative data showing notes were read a lot, but built on less.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Noticed only the quantitative data generated by the KCA; did not recognize the cognitive opportunities afforded by the qualitative information provided. Expressed dissatisfaction with work quality.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Unhappy with the quality of notes; wondering whether notes have been improved and ideas developed.
related_quotes: I am wondering whether my notes have been improved and the ideas have been developed. According to the KCA data, my notes have been read a lot, but built on less. What is worse, no notes are referred to by others. My notes lack thought-provoking questions .
I am not happy with the quality of my notes; it has much room to be improved.

behavior_patterns.condition: Immediately after the introduction of the KCA
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Noticed only the quantitative data generated by the KCA; did not recognize the cognitive opportunities afforded by the qualitative information provided

behavior_patterns.condition: When analyzing KCA data showing notes were read but not built on
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Identified specific missing elements like thought-provoking questions and external references; generated further plans to address the problems
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Unhappy with the quality of notes; wondering whether notes have been improved and ideas developed
related_quotes: I am not happy with the quality of my notes; it has much room to be improved. I think I can use keywords and refer to others ’notes .
